item.title: Arthur Brooks: Mike Tomlin’s ‘Minecraft’ Hobby Is a Lesson in Happiness
item.description:
In January this year, the coach of the Pittsburgh Steelers resigned, following 19 seasons at the helm. After much “thought and reflection”—presumably, about the team’s prolonged lack of postseason success (they had not won a playoff game since the 2016 season)—Mike Tomlin stepped down.
